title: Low light
summary: Settings for indoors, city lights and stars.

items: Av mode with the widest aperture lets the most light in.
In Av, Tv or P, turn exposure compensation to + to brighten.
High ISO noise cleans up best from RAW files.
A lens at f/2.8 or wider and image stabilisation help most.
